title: She won a top Venice Film Festival prize in 2025. In 2026, she won another one - for a different film.

sources.text: Outlook India - Anuparna Roy's Lovers In The Blue Night Wins NETPAC Award at Venice Film Festival 2026
ThePrint - Anuparna Roy's Lovers in the Blue Night wins NETPAC award at Venice Film Festival

caption:
She won a top Venice Film Festival prize in 2025. In 2026, she won another one - for a different film.

The Bengal-born filmmaker's second feature, set in Mumbai and following four people navigating love and belonging, premiered in Venice's Orizzonti section on September 11, 2026, with the award reported days later.

Two different films, two consecutive years, two of Venice's most selective sections - a rare run for any filmmaker, let alone one still early in her career.

Roy's consecutive Venice wins signal that Indian independent cinema's international reputation isn't a one-off - it's becoming a pattern festivals now expect.
